products.label: Products
products.klar_desc: High solar rejection with durable dye technology. Available in 5%, 20%, 35% and 50% transmission.
products.karbon_desc: Carbon nanoparticle technology for maximum solar rejection without signal interference.
products.keramx_desc: The best window film technology: high-performance nanoceramic with superior optical clarity.
products.krypton_desc: Nanoceramic technology with fragment retention on impact and intrusion resistance. Maximum protection for occupants and assets.
products.ppf_desc: Invisible automotive paint protection against impacts, scratches and chemical agents.
products.vitral_desc: Solar control for high-end commercial and residential glazing. Decorative and privacy options.
products.nicho_autos_desc: Solar control and security films for vehicle glass, in standard and premium lines.
products.nicho_arquitectura_desc: Films for commercial and residential glazing: solar control, mirror finish, security and decoration.
products.cat_klass_desc: Functional solar control with 1 ply construction for professional applications. Reliability and performance.
products.cat_kortex_desc: High infrared rejection in a 1 ply construction. An efficient, well-balanced solution within the Standard line.
products.cat_kron_desc: Excellent visibility and multiple transmission levels in 1 ply construction. A versatile solution that balances comfort, aesthetics and clarity.
products.cat_klar_desc: 2 ply construction that adds extra body and strength. Designed to deliver a high level of solar protection, thermal comfort and durability.
products.cat_kryon_desc: Nanoceramic technology in 2 ply construction with high infrared rejection. Thermal comfort and superior protection, backed by a 5-year warranty.
products.cat_kore_desc: Premium Dyed plus Sputtering technology in 2 ply construction with high optical quality and a superior finish. Designed to deliver clarity, UV protection and lasting performance.
products.cat_karbon_desc: Nanocarbon technology combining high heat rejection with excellent optical clarity. Superior comfort and great visibility, with no interference with electronic signals.
products.cat_keramx_desc: High-performance nanoceramic technology with 95% infrared rejection and exceptional optical clarity. Superior thermal comfort and maximum protection.
products.cat_krypton_desc: Security and nanoceramic technology in a single film. Reinforces the glass, helps hold fragments together on impact, and delivers superior thermal protection.
products.cat_ppf_desc: High-performance clear protection that preserves paint against impacts, scratches and external agents. Thermal self-healing technology keeps the finish flawless for longer.
products.cat_kaiser_desc: Nanoceramic technology combined with high-performance sputtering, delivering superior solar control, excellent optical clarity and thermal protection. Developed for the most demanding applications.
products.cat_kreflect_silver_desc: High-performance reflective technology with a mirror finish. Reduces heat gain and adds greater privacy, optimizing solar control on glazed surfaces.
products.cat_klear_desc: High-strength clear protection that reinforces the glass and helps hold fragments together on impact or breakage. Available in 8 and 12 mil for different levels of protection.
products.cat_knight_desc: Matte-finish blackout designed to block view and light. Total privacy for spaces that require maximum visual isolation.
products.cat_kwhite_matte_desc: Frosted white finish that adds privacy while letting natural light through. An elegant solution to transform and define glazed spaces.
products.cat_kdecor_stripe_desc: White and clear stripes that balance privacy, light and design. A contemporary solution for glazed spaces.

about.hero_body:
Kristall works alongside specialized factories in solar control, security and surface protection solutions, integrating multilayer technologies, thermal rejection and digital tools focused on the professional market.

More than two decades of experience manufacturing technical films for automotive and architectural applications back every reference in the catalog.
about.timeline_1_body: The base technology was born in precision optics laboratories in Germany, focused on solar control in high-demand industrial glazing.
about.timeline_2_body: The multilayer formulation was adapted for automotive applications, achieving unprecedented infrared rejection levels in thin films.
about.timeline_3_body: Obtaining international quality certifications and first expansion into Latin American and Asia Pacific markets.
about.timeline_4_body: Launch of the Paint Protection Film line with thermal recovery polymer, extending the brand into the premium paint protection segment.
about.timeline_5_body: Dr Polarizados incorporates Kristall Film as a premium regional distribution brand, bringing German technology to the Argentine and Latin American market.
about.values_1_body: Every film is measured, tested and validated before leaving production.
about.values_2_body: The same production standard in every batch. What you install today is identical to what you installed last year.
about.values_3_body: We publish complete technical data sheets. Every specification is measurable and verifiable by the installer or end customer.
about.values_4_body: German-origin technology available today in Argentina and Latin America, with local support and regional response times.
about.values_5_body: Brand backing on every certified installation.
about.values_6_body: Reduction of thermal load in buildings and vehicles.
about.values_7_body: Specialized team for installers and distributors.
about.cert_2_body: North American standard for solar control films
